description: Reviews MCPForge CLI registry publication commands, including the --allow-unverified override. This optional rule does not verify generated servers or grant registry permissions.
name: MCPForge registry publish protection
saferAlternatives: Verify the registry destination, project slug, account and selected tools before publishing.
Run the supported MCPForge mock compatibility test first; --allow-unverified skips the normal verification gate.
Use a draft publication when appropriate, and inspect the generated project before publishing.
